title: MCP health check reads a multi-megabyte tools/list reply
objective: Add src/wev_skills/third_party/health.py with health(source: Source, version: str, root: Path, runner: SubprocessRunner, *, npx: str) -> HealthReport. For the rea MCP source it starts `npx -y rea-agents@<version> mcp` (the npx argument names the executable), speaks JSON-RPC over stdio (initialize, then tools/list) and returns HealthReport(ok, code, params) where ok is True with params["tools"] set to the number of tools listed. The server's reply to tools/list arrives as a single line and can be several megabytes; the report must still be ok. tests/fixtures/fake_npx_mcp.py is a stand-in server you can run.
